mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the unemployment rate above 8% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and earnings pressure, which reduces corporate profit growth and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 8% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for three consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of three consecutive quarterly declines in GDPC1 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate by more than 100 basis points within a single month signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by > 1.00% in one month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of > 100bp single-month FEDFUNDS increases (t-test p > 0.05).
